quest.d: Hi. I’m buying a birthday present for my grandmother.
What should I get for her?
What did you buy her last year?
I bought her a scarf.
Should I get her another scarf this year?
I don’t think so. You should get her something different.
Do you have any ideas?
Hmmm. Does she like tea? You could get her a teapot.
That’s a good idea!
And they’re on sale!
I’m buying a birthday present for my aunt.
What should I get for her?
Does she like to cook? You could get her a cookbook.
I don’t think so. She already has a lot of cookbooks.
These chocolates look delicious.
You could get her a box of chocolates.
I don’t think so. I got her a box of chocolates last year.
Does she like movies? You could get her a DVD.
This is her favorite actor.
I think you should get her that DVD. She’ll love it!
I’m buying a birthday present for my uncle.
What should I get for him?
How old is he?
He’s going to be 25.
Does he like skateboards?
I don’t think so.
He gave me his skateboard last year.
How about this T-shirt? Or that watch?
That watch is great. It’s his favorite color.
I think you should get him that watch. He’ll love it.
